provenance.method: Need-led shift-work sleep route using NHS general sleep guidance; employment decisions are not made by ND Oracle.

question: Shift work or changing schedules keeps breaking my sleep routine. What can I inspect?
why_it_matters: Variable schedules can disrupt sleep timing and remove the predictability that some neurodivergent people use to wind down and recover.
current_understanding: Treat schedule variation as a real sleep factor rather than a personal failure. Inspect predictable pre-sleep cues, light/noise control and how much the rota changes. If the pattern is causing persistent insomnia, unsafe sleepiness or major daytime impairment, use a clinical route; workplace changes may also belong in an adjustment discussion rather than a sleep tip alone.
evidence_needed: Evidence on neurodivergence, shift work and circadian disruption.
Workplace guidance on reasonable schedule adjustments where disability-related barriers are involved.
reopening_conditions: NHS or occupational guidance adds stronger shift-work pathways.
Evidence supports more precise practical recommendations.
dissent: Not everyone can make their rota predictable, so individual coping strategies may have limited effect without workplace change.
